notes.title: Demo Patch: Performance Improvements + Graphics Settings
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

A new patch is now live for the Timelake: Time Travel Tactics Demo, focusing on performance upgrades and graphics scalability — based directly on your feedback. Huge thanks to everyone who took the time to report issues and share system details.

🔧 Patch Highlights:
[list]
[*]Improved overall FPS and more stable performance during gameplay, especially in complex scenes
[*]Initial visual adjustments made for different screen sizes and quality levels — further tuning is ongoing
[*]Introduced multiple adjustable graphics settings to better support a wide range of hardware setups
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416723/100b77f73a426477300587d17c6186d924961266.jpg[/img]
This is part of ongoing optimization as the demo evolves. More updates are coming — your feedback continues to guide development.

– CatenaryCat
